description: Historical Municipal Landfills is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Parks. The Historical Municipal Landfills dataset is a spatial representation of the locations of historic landfills in the province of Alberta. The data was originally captured in a 1982 survey conducted by MacLaren Plansearch Lavalin where counties within Alberta were asked to identify the quarter section that landfills were located in. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Parks. Its tags are -CANADA, ALBERTA, ASSOCIATED-ENGINEERING, DISPOSAL, DUMP. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
